property_summary: After calling setOwner(address) as the original owner, the owner becomes the argument address in the reference but msg.sender in the buggy version, so when called by address(0x123) with argument address(0x456), the reference sets owner to 0x456 and the buggy set to 0x123.
change_summary: Swap the assignment operand: assign the caller (msg.sender) instead of the argument _owner.
mutated_unit_code: function setOwner(address _owner) public onlyOwner returns (bool success) { owner = msg.sender; return true; }
